title: Adityapur-Jamshedpur Performance Reference & Expected Operating Envelope
rule: L3 defines how GridMind establishes comparable performance references. It never assumes first-period data is healthy.

reference_model.operational_baseline: Observed behaviour under a defined operating context; descriptive, not a health claim.
reference_model.intervention_baseline: Comparable pre-intervention period reserved for measurement and verification.
reference_model.reference_selection: Select comparable periods/states after excluding known abnormal, maintenance, startup, shutdown, changeover and contaminated periods.
contamination_rules: exclude maintenance and known fault periods
reference_model.unknown_policy: If evidence cannot support an expected envelope, return INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE or REFERENCE_UNCERTAIN.

forging.envelope_method: Compare like product/material/process states; normalize energy and cycle metrics to load and production where supported.

machining.envelope_method: Compare like machining operations and operating states; do not infer tool or bearing health from energy alone.

thermal.envelope_method: Normalize thermal input to comparable load and process recipe; separate startup, soak, production and shutdown states.

rotating.envelope_method: Compare at comparable speed/load/process conditions; vibration reference requires defined measurement location and acquisition quality.

hydraulic.envelope_method: Use pressure-flow-load relationships under comparable operating states; do not infer leakage without sufficient evidence.

electrical.envelope_method: Normalize electrical behaviour to loading and operating state; distinguish supply anomaly from asset anomaly.

utilities.envelope_method: Use efficiency/output relationships at comparable load; avoid absolute efficiency claims without adequate measurement.

material_handling.envelope_method: Compare equivalent duty cycles and loads; safety-critical conclusions require qualified inspection.

metrology.envelope_method: Performance reference is measurement-system validity, not machine health.

uncertainty.principle: A deviation is meaningful only when it exceeds relevant measurement and model uncertainty.
uncertainty.policy: Do not create a degradation finding when observed deviation is indistinguishable from known uncertainty.

change_detection: new energy source such as solar
gating: L3 does not authorize fault diagnosis.
Expected envelope requires comparable operating context.
First 30 days are not automatically healthy.
Specifications constrain permissible operation but do not prove actual health.
Diagnostics remain blocked until L4 evidence requirements are satisfied.
Verified savings remain blocked until intervention measurement and M&V requirements are satisfied.
